title: 英国脱欧十年后：首相更迭频繁 伯南姆崛起
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So the favourite right now to lead Britain was just sworn into Parliament today, literally hours after Starmer stepped down. Who is Andy Burnham? And why has he become a major player so quickly?
segments.zh: 目前最有望领导英国的人今天刚宣誓就职，就在斯塔默卸任几小时后。安迪·伯纳姆是谁？为何他这么快成为关键人物？

segments.en: Well, he's a long, I think the first thing to say, he's a long term figure in the Labour Party.
segments.zh: 首先，他是工党资深人物。

segments.en: This is not someone who's a stranger to Labour. He's grown up in the Labour movement and has been active in it for many, since the days of the Blair Governments.
segments.zh: 他并非工党新人，在工党运动中成长，自布莱尔政府时期就活跃其中。

segments.en: I think most recently known for being mayor of Manchester.
segments.zh: 最近他因担任曼彻斯特市长而闻名。

segments.en: I think that was the really, you saw that the political reinvention of Andy Burnham, he came out and colloquially known as the King of the North and the emergence of this thing
segments.zh: 他的政治重塑始于曼彻斯特，被称为“北方之王”，并催生了“曼彻斯特主义”。

segments.en: called Manchesterism, which is essentially a mix of state control, mixed with working with business
segments.zh: 这是一种国家控制与商业合作相结合的模式，旨在促进发展。

segments.en: to promote development. Before Manchester, of course, he was a Labour MP for many years and it's important to note this is someone who he ran for the Labour leadership in 2010 and lost. He ran in
segments.zh: 在此之前，他长期担任工党议员，曾在2010年和2015年竞选党魁，均告失败。

segments.en: 2015 again and lost to Jeremy Corbyn. So this is somebody who's no stranger to the Labour Party.
segments.zh: 2015年他输给了杰里米·科尔宾。所以他对工党并不陌生。

segments.en: And why was it significant that he won that election in Maker Field?
segments.zh: 他赢得梅克菲尔德选区补选为何意义重大？

segments.en: Who did he beat? And what was the rising tide in that district?
segments.zh: 他击败了谁？该选区的上升趋势是什么？

segments.en: Well, firstly, it was extraordinary, there was a bilaction in the first place in the previous MP, you know, just been elected at Simons, had to step down to clear the way for Burnham to do it.
segments.zh: 首先，这很不寻常，前任议员刚当选就辞职，为伯纳姆让路。

segments.en: And you can't be party leader unless you're in Parliament here.
segments.zh: 在这里，除非你在议会，否则不能成为党魁。
